name: tempo
description: Grafana Tempo, an open source, easy-to-use, and high-scale distributed tracing backend. This all-in-one configuration runs the distributor, ingester, and querier components in a single process, accepting traces via OTLP (gRPC/HTTP) and storing them on local disk. Query traces through Grafana by adding Tempo as a data source pointed at this container's HTTP API port. A tempo.yaml configuration file must exist at the mapped config path before starting the container. https://grafana.com/oss/tempo/

paths.name: Config File
paths.description: Path to the tempo.yaml configuration file. Must exist before starting the container.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Storage location for ingested trace data.

ports.name: Container Port 1
ports.description: Tempo HTTP API / query endpoint, used by Grafana as a data source.

ports.name: Container Port 2
ports.description: OTLP gRPC receiver for ingesting trace data from OpenTelemetry SDKs.

ports.name: Container Port 3
ports.description: OTLP HTTP receiver for ingesting trace data from OpenTelemetry SDKs.

variables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
variables.description: Optional OTLP endpoint for Tempo to export its own internal telemetry to, e.g. http://alloy:4318 if running an Alloy or OTel Collector instance. Leave blank to disable.
